title: server list
description: What servers answers with -o json: every server on this machine and whether it answered just now. A person or script finds the servers that run and where; a record a server left behind shows as not answering (ADR-S04, ADR-S12).

kind.description: Always ServerList, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: One row per server record found on this machine.

items.description: One server: its record and whether it answers.

record.description: The record the server wrote when it started (server.schema.json). It says what the server claimed; only answering says whether it runs now.

answering.description: The record's address answered as this app just now. A record can outlive its server, so this is the field to believe.
